summary: Karooooo Ltd., a Singapore-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing it will report second-quarter fiscal 2027 financial results on October 19, 2026, after 04:00 p.m. Eastern Time, with a Zoom webinar on October 20, 2026. No special-situation transaction or corporate action is disclosed. The release also notes Karooooo owns 100% of Cartrack and 81% of Karooooo Logistics. This is a routine earnings-date notice, not an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation.
